title: astragalus angustifolius subsp. violaceus
intro: Astragalus angustifolius subsp. violaceus, commonly known as Purple Astragalus, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat a variety of health conditions. The health benefits of Purple Astragalus include its immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which can help to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties.
